title: OAuth client secret rotation
content: OAuth client secret rotation. Rotate the replacement secret in the AcmeCloud console, deploy it to every worker, then revoke the old secret. A worker using a cached old secret receives HTTP 401 until its credential cache is refreshed. The JavaScript SDK 4.2.1 fixes a cache invalidation defect present in 4.2.0. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: oauth rotation 401 secret credential cache.

title: API access token lifetime
content: API access token lifetime. API access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens can obtain a new access token without asking the user to sign in again. Check the token expiry claim and clock skew before retrying a 401 response. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: token expiry refresh 401.

title: Okta SSO configuration
content: Okta SSO configuration. Create a SAML application in Okta, copy the entity ID and ACS URL from AcmeCloud, then upload the Okta signing certificate. Assign the Okta group to the application and map email to NameID. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: okta saml sso configuration.

title: SSO role mapping
content: SSO role mapping. Standard users need both an Okta application assignment and an AcmeCloud role mapping. If admins can sign in but standard users cannot, inspect the group claim and default role policy. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: sso standard users role mapping.

title: Webhook signature verification
content: Webhook signature verification. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body using the endpoint signing secret. Compare the result with the X-Acme-Signature header using a constant-time comparison. Do not parse and reserialize JSON before verification. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: webhook signature hmac raw body.

title: Multiple webhook endpoints
content: Multiple webhook endpoints. An organization can register up to ten webhook endpoints. Each endpoint has its own signing secret, event subscriptions, and retry policy. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: multiple webhook endpoints.

title: API rate limits
content: API rate limits. The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per organization. HTTP 429 responses include Retry-After; use exponential backoff with jitter and avoid immediate retries. This is the maintained product procedure. Verify configuration in a staging environment before applying it to production. Context: rate limit 429 retry after.

title: Release 4.0.2: API access token lifetime
content: Release 4.0.2: API access token lifetime. API access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens can obtain a new access token without asking the user to sign in again. Check the token expiry claim and clock skew before retrying a 401 response. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: token expiry refresh 401.

title: Release 4.0.3: Okta SSO configuration
content: Release 4.0.3: Okta SSO configuration. Create a SAML application in Okta, copy the entity ID and ACS URL from AcmeCloud, then upload the Okta signing certificate. Assign the Okta group to the application and map email to NameID. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: okta saml sso configuration.

title: Release 4.0.4: SSO role mapping
content: Release 4.0.4: SSO role mapping. Standard users need both an Okta application assignment and an AcmeCloud role mapping. If admins can sign in but standard users cannot, inspect the group claim and default role policy. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: sso standard users role mapping.

title: Release 4.0.5: Webhook signature verification
content: Release 4.0.5: Webhook signature verification. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body using the endpoint signing secret. Compare the result with the X-Acme-Signature header using a constant-time comparison. Do not parse and reserialize JSON before verification. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: webhook signature hmac raw body.

title: Release 4.0.6: Multiple webhook endpoints
content: Release 4.0.6: Multiple webhook endpoints. An organization can register up to ten webhook endpoints. Each endpoint has its own signing secret, event subscriptions, and retry policy. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: multiple webhook endpoints.

title: Release 4.0.7: API rate limits
content: Release 4.0.7: API rate limits. The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per organization. This release note records a product change and points to the current guide for the supported procedure. Context: rate limit 429 retry after.
